- Vanity, fixture, flooring, and lighting replacement
- Accessible / aging-in-place bathroom design
- Supply-only shower pans, wall systems, and hydrotherapy tubs

## Pricing (Littleton, CO — 2026)

Premium and budget-conscious projects are both served. The spread between them is
driven by installation parameters, not by quality of materials or workmanship.

| Project | Typical range | Time on site |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Supply-only shower pan | Under $2,000 | Ships in days |
| Shower walls only (existing pan retained) | From $4,500 | 1 day |
| One-day Crestline shower installation | $6,900 - $10,500 | 1 day |
| Tub-to-shower conversion | $8,500 - $14,500 | 2-4 days |
| Walk-in tub (ADA) | From $9,500 | 2-3 days |
| Midrange full bathroom remodel | $10,000 - $18,000 | 2-3 weeks |
| Curbless barrier-free shower | $10,000 - $18,000 | 3-5 days |
| Custom tile shower | $12,000 - $20,000+ | 1-2 weeks |
| Full custom tile bathroom | $15,000 - $25,000+ | 3-4 weeks |

Budget-friendly shower remodels can finish under $10,000 fully installed when the
layout cooperates and finish selections stay practical. Many Colorado contractors
quote $30,000 or more for a single custom shower; that figure is common in this
market but is not the only available price point.

Cost split on a typical project: labor 40-55%, materials and fixtures 30-45%,
permits/disposal/protection 5-10%.

Primary cost drivers: whether the drain moves, subfloor condition, panel system vs
custom tile, door and glass selection, valve replacement or relocation, curbless
entry structural work, layout changes, permits, and whether installation is turnkey
or supply-only.

## Supply-only policy

Homeowners may purchase the shower pan, wall system, or hydrotherapy bathtub and
install it themselves or use their own contractor. The manufacturer warranty remains
in full effect provided the unit is installed according to manufacturer guidelines.
The 5-year workmanship warranty applies only to work performed by Aging Safely Baths
crews. Supply-only orders ship through showers4less.com.

## Crestline shower system

Crestline is Best Bath's high-pressure laminate shower wall system. Panels are
3/8-inch thick, HPL front surface on a marine-grade plywood backer with a factory
vapor barrier. Grout-free, non-porous, mold-resistant, and installs in a single day
over most existing substrates. 30-year manufacturer warranty. Patterns: Grey Slate,
Dark Grey Marble, Beige Limestone, White Marble. Available in single-panel back wall
and split-seam configurations.

## Permits

A like-for-like fixture swap generally requires no permit. Relocating a drain, moving
or adding a valve, adding a circuit or exhaust fan, or enlarging a shower does.
Permits are issued by the City of Littleton, Arapahoe County, Jefferson County, or
Douglas County depending on the parcel. Permits are pulled where required and fees
are passed through at cost on the written quote.
